- Central and Western USA: 3 to 6 days

My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If your tracking shows delivered but you have not received the package, the recommended next steps are:
Check around the delivery location
Inspect all entrances, side doors, porches, garages, parcel lockers, or mailrooms.
Consult with neighbors or building management in case the package was left nearby.
Review the tracking details carefully
Carriers sometimes include notes indicating where the package was left.
Allow a little extra time
Carriers may occasionally mark a package as delivered shortly before it actually arrives.
Contact the carrier directly
Request delivery details or GPS confirmation if available.
